name: Malta — Maltese parties
intro: compare it with Maltese political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Malta: those represented in the parliament (Kamra tad-Deputati) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Kamra tad-Deputati) after the 2022 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 79 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

ADPD.name: ADPD – The Green Party
ADPD.priorities: Climate action, Rule of law, Public services
ADPD.description: Malta's green party, outside parliament, campaigning on the environment, overdevelopment and good governance.

PL.name: Partit Laburista
PL.priorities: Welfare state, Competitiveness and growth, Cost of living
PL.description: Labour Party of Prime Minister Robert Abela, in power since 2013; it legalised cannabis for personal use in 2021.

Volt.name: Volt Malta
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

PN.name: Partit Nazzjonalista
PN.priorities: Rule of law, Fighting corruption, Traditional family values
PN.description: Nationalist Party, Christian-democratic and pro-European, the main opposition force.
